sections.tldr: TL;DR: The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade online MBA is a UGC-DEB approved two-year Master of Business Administration, delivered fully online. Indian Institute of Foreign Trade holds NAAC A+ accreditation. Offered as a broad MBA covering the core curriculum. It suits working professionals and graduates who want a management qualification without leaving their job. For the current confirmed fee and EMI options, speak with our counsellor, since the fee for this programme is verified case by case rather than published as a fixed table.

hero.headline: Indian Institute of Foreign Trade Online MBA
hero.sub: A UGC-DEB approved, NAAC A+ Master of Business Administration, delivered online.

ugcDeb.heading: Indian Institute of Foreign Trade Online MBA: UGC-DEB Approval and Validity
ugcDeb.body: The UGC Distance Education Bureau regulates every online degree in India. Indian Institute of Foreign Trade is UGC-DEB entitled for online delivery, which means this MBA is valid for government and PSU recruitment, for private-sector employment, and for higher study at recognised Indian universities. Indian Institute of Foreign Trade also holds NAAC A+ accreditation. Always confirm the current entitlement for your admission year at deb.ugc.ac.in before you enrol.

abcId.heading: Academic Bank of Credits (ABC ID)
abcId.body: Every student in a UGC-approved online programme needs an Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) ID. You create it free on the ABC portal at abc.gov.in, usually through your DigiLocker account. As you clear each semester of the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade online MBA, your credits are deposited against this ID, which makes it easier to carry credits forward or move to senior management roles or a specialised certification later. Keep the same ABC ID through the whole two-year programme.

redFlags.heading: What to Check Before You Enrol

flags.sentence1: Indian Institute of Foreign Trade does not publish a single fixed fee table for this online MBA.
flags.sentence2: Get the current fee and any EMI terms confirmed in writing before you pay, rather than relying on a figure quoted elsewhere.

flags.sentence1: This is a fully online programme with no on-campus classes.
flags.sentence2: If you want in-person teaching or a campus experience, this is not the right format for you.

flags.sentence1: Online study is self-driven and career support is not guaranteed.
flags.sentence2: Plan to build your own study routine, and expect to run your own job search after you graduate.

flags.sentence1: UGC-DEB entitlement is granted intake by intake.
flags.sentence2: Confirm that Indian Institute of Foreign Trade is on the current approved list at deb.ugc.ac.in for your admission year before you enrol.

faqs.question: Is the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade online MBA valid?
faqs.answer: Yes. Indian Institute of Foreign Trade is UGC-DEB entitled for online delivery and holds NAAC A+. The MBA is valid for employment, for government and PSU recruitment, and for higher study at recognised Indian universities. Confirm the current status at deb.ugc.ac.in.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade online MBA?
faqs.answer: You need a bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university. The online format is built for people who want to study while they work. Confirm the exact cut-off with the university before applying.

faqs.question: How long is the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade online MBA?
faqs.answer: It is a two-year programme delivered fully online, which lets you study around work or other commitments.

faqs.question: Who should consider the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade online MBA?
faqs.answer: It suits working professionals and graduates who want a management qualification without leaving their job, and carries local weight around New Delhi, Delhi. For the MBA you would study management strategy, finance, marketing, operations and people leadership, and typical early roles include management trainee, business analyst, operations executive. Many graduates go on to senior management roles or a specialised certification.

faqs.question: What is the fee for the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade online MBA?
faqs.answer: The current confirmed fee is verified case by case rather than published as a fixed table. Speak with our counsellor for the latest fee and EMI options, and confirm the figure with the university in writing before you pay.
